turns.question: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, how many euros less did a first-time buyer's order come to, on average, than a returning customer's?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that splits order value into first-time and returning buyers, so I cannot give that difference; the closest is Average order value (EUR), which came to 66.79 EUR per non-cancelled order across all customers from 1 to 10 October 2026, not split by buyer type, and the closest related metrics are Repeat-customer revenue share and Repeat customers. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
